en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who recites [97:1] We have indeed revealed this in the Night of Predestination, being loud with it by his voice, would be like the brandisher of his sword in the Way of Allahazwj;
and the one who recites it privately would be like the one rolling in his blood in the Way of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>;
and the one who recites it ten times, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Forgive (his sins) for him upon an approximation of a thousand sins from his sins’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from Sayf ibn ‘Umayrah from a man from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Whoever reads Chapter 97 of the Holy Quran aloud, he is considered as one unsheathing his sword in the way of Allah,
whoever reads it silently he is considered as one who has been socked with his own blood in the way of Allah
and whoever reads it ten times, about one thousand of his sins will be forgiven.”
